jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Translational Pancreatitis and Thromboinflammation Research; part time 65  (m/w/d) (Forschungsreferent/in)
jobs.description:
Scope of duties

· Work on the Collaborative Research Centre project (SFB) “Thromboinflammatory mechanisms of pancreatitis progression and associated splanchnic and portal vein thrombosis”
· Investigate cellular and molecular mechanisms that link pancreatic inflammation, coagulation and thrombotic complications
· Study the role of platelet–neutrophil interactions and sphingolipid metabolism in acute and acute-on-chronic pancreatitis
· Plan and perform experimental studies using cellular systems, patient-derived biosamples and established preclinical models of pancreatitis
· Apply modern molecular, biochemical and cell biological methods, including cell culture, flow cytometry, immunofluorescence microscopy, RNA and protein analysis and functional cellular assays
· Contribute to the characterization of inflammatory, thrombotic and metabolic pathways using proteomic, lipidomic or transcriptomic approaches
· Participate in the development and validation of targeted therapeutic strategies, including nanoparticle- and aptamer-based delivery approaches
· Quantitatively analyze, interpret and document experimental and clinical research data
· Collaborate closely with scientists, clinicians and technology platforms within the interdisciplinary Collaborative Research Centre
· Present research findings at internal meetings and national and international scientific conferences and contribute to scientific publications

Our requirements

· A successfully completed university degree, preferably a Master’s degree or equivalent, in biology, biochemistry, molecular medicine, biotechnology, pharmacy or a related life-science discipline
· Strong interest in translational research, inflammation, pancreatitis, vascular biology or immunology
· Practical experience in molecular and cell biology, for example mammalian cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, immunoblotting, quantitative PCR or functional cellular assays
· Previous experience with primary cells, patient samples, animal models, proteomics, lipidomics, nanoparticles or drug-delivery systems is an advantage, but not mandatory
· Motivation to learn new experimental technologies and quantitative analysis methods
· A careful, structured and reliable approach to experimental work
· Scientific curiosity, high motivation and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
· Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment
· Very good written and spoken English
· German language skills are not required

Our offer

· An innovative PhD project within an interdisciplinary Collaborative Research Centre at LMU University Hospital

· A translational research environment combining experimental pancreatitis research, vascular biology, immunology and clinical medicine
· The opportunity to work with patient-derived biosamples, established disease models and modern molecular and imaging technologies
· State-of-the-art laboratories and access to advanced flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics, lipidomics and data-analysis platforms
· Close collaboration with basic scientists, clinician scientists, bioinformaticians and experts in vascular and inflammatory biology
· Integration into a highly collaborative national research network with opportunities for scientific exchange across several disciplines
· Structured scientific supervision and support for professional and personal development
· Opportunities to participate in scientific workshops, training programmes and national and international conferences
· A supportive and inspiring working environment that encourages scientific independence and the development of new ideas
· Employment according to the German public-sector collective agreement, including annual leave and additional benefits in accordance with the applicable regulations
· The position is initially limited to three years. The precise wording regarding a possible extension should be adapted to the SFB funding conditions
· The position is based at LMU University Hospital, Campus Großhadern, in Munich
· Remuneration is based on the Collective Agreement for the Public Sector of the Länder (TV-L) including all allowances customary in the public sector.

jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Data Mining & Web Scraping Automation (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) 

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) 

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents 

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) 

About the Research Institute: 

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) conducts applied research into spatial data systems, automated data extraction, and infrastructure transformation. We build scalable data pipelines to turn fragmented public records into structured spatial insights. 

What We Offer: 

We fully sponsor and support your relocation journey to Germany via the Opportunity Card framework, managing visa formalities, degree assessments, and onboarding logistics. You will benefit from organized accommodation, living allowances during training, sponsored German language classes, and hands-on exposure to production-grade data mining environments. 

Your Role & Key Tasks: 

You will design, develop, and maintain autonomous scraping routines and extraction agents for public registers, corporate filings, and official announcements. You will parse complex unstructured document formats—such as HTML, PDF, JSON, and XML—into clean, relational data structures, while monitoring data feeds and integrating incoming datasets into our core spatial repositories. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications: 

Applicants should hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical subject. You should possess solid foundations or a strong motivation to develop your skills in Python (using libraries such as Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, or Playwright), text parsing, regex, and structured data modelling. Fluent English is required. 

How to Apply: 

Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter in English. We look forward to reviewing your application! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

jobs.description:

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) 

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents 

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) 

About the Research Institute: 

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is a non-profit, applied research institute dedicated to developing cutting-edge spatial resilience data models and open-data architectures for the energy transition, critical infrastructure, and sustainable regional planning. 

What We Offer: 

We provide comprehensive administrative support for international candidates, including full assistance with the German Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), degree recognition, and visa procedures. You will receive structured onboarding, local accommodation support, coverage of basic living expenses during training, on-site sponsored German language courses, and access to a modern data engineering tech stack centered on Python, PostGIS, Docker, and GIS platforms. 

Your Role & Key Tasks: 

In this role, you will build and maintain automated Python-based spatial data pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms. You will implement spatial overlay and inference models for energy grid matching and land-use analysis, while validating, structuring, and transforming vector geometries into our central PostgreSQL and PostGIS databases. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications: 

We welcome applicants with a completed university degree in Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical discipline. You should bring practical experience or a strong learning interest in Python (GeoPandas, Shapely), SQL databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS), spatial reference systems, and automated data ingestion workflows. High motivation and fluent English skills are required. 

How to Apply: 

Please submit your CV along with a short cover letter in English. We look forward to welcoming you to the IRIS team! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)
